mapper.select: INSERT INTO todo (id, tenant_id, service, business_key, opened, occurred_at, occurred_at_nanos, title, body, permission_code, app_code, route, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{event.tenantId}, #{event.service}, #{event.businessKey}, true, #{second}, #{nanos}, #{event.title}, #{event.body}, #{event.target.permissionCode}, #{event.link.appCode}, #{event.link.route}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, service, business_key) WHERE NOT deleted DO UPDATE SET opened = true, occurred_at = EXCLUDED.occurred_at, occurred_at_nanos = EXCLUDED.occurred_at_nanos, title = EXCLUDED.title, body = EXCLUDED.body, permission_code = EXCLUDED.permission_code, app_code = EXCLUDED.app_code, route = EXCLUDED.route, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = NULL WHERE NOT todo.deleted AND (todo.occurred_at < EXCLUDED.occurred_at OR (todo.occurred_at = EXCLUDED.occurred_at AND todo.occurred_at_nanos < EXCLUDED.occurred_at_nanos)) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo (id, tenant_id, service, business_key, opened, occurred_at, occurred_at_nanos, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{event.tenantId}, #{event.service}, #{event.businessKey}, false, #{second}, #{nanos}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, service, business_key) WHERE NOT deleted DO UPDATE SET opened = false, occurred_at = EXCLUDED.occurred_at, occurred_at_nanos = EXCLUDED.occurred_at_nanos, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = NULL WHERE NOT todo.deleted AND (todo.occurred_at < EXCLUDED.occurred_at OR (todo.occurred_at = EXCLUDED.occurred_at AND todo.occurred_at_nanos < EXCLUDED.occurred_at_nanos))
